title.zh: Bybit accepts Franklin Templeton tokenized funds as trading collateral
title.en: Bybit accepts Franklin Templeton tokenized funds as trading collateral

current_state.zh: Franklin Templeton and Bybit launched a program letting eligible institutional clients pledge Benji-issued tokenized money market fund shares, held in off-exchange custody, as collateral for USDT/USDC credit lines used to trade on Bybit.
current_state.en: Franklin Templeton and Bybit launched a program letting eligible institutional clients pledge Benji-issued tokenized money market fund shares, held in off-exchange custody, as collateral for USDT/USDC credit lines used to trade on Bybit.
